| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Control mode | `fuelPumpMode` | choice |  | Single relay preserves normal priming and engine-motion control. Dual stages a second relay. PWM regulates low fuel pressure. Burn changes to mode, pins or PWM frequency before use. |
| Output | `fuelPumpPin` | choice |  | https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~outputs |
| Output mode | `fuelPumpPinMode` | choice |  |  |
| Prime duration | `startUpFuelPumpDuration` | seconds | 0 … 6000 | on IGN voltage detection turn fuel pump on to build fuel pressure |
| Output | `fuelPump2Pin` | choice |  | Secondary pump relay output, used in Dual relay mode. https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~outputs |
| Output mode | `fuelPump2PinMode` | choice |  | Secondary pump output polarity. |
| Activation RPM | `secondaryFpActivationRpm` | rpm | 0 … 20000 | Secondary pump engages only when RPM, fueling load and TPS all exceed their thresholds. |
| Activation load | `secondaryFpActivationLoad` | load | 0 … 1000 | Fueling-load threshold for the secondary pump. Speed Density uses MAP in kPa, other fueling algorithms use their own load scale. |
| Activation TPS | `secondaryFpActivationTps` | % | 0 … 100 | TPS threshold for the secondary pump. |
| RPM hysteresis | `secondaryFpRpmHysteresis` | rpm | 0 … 20000 | RPM release hysteresis for the secondary pump. |
| Load hysteresis | `secondaryFpLoadHysteresis` | load | 0 … 1000 | Fueling-load release hysteresis for the secondary pump. |
| TPS hysteresis | `secondaryFpTpsHysteresis` | % | 0 … 100 | Secondary pump releases when any input falls below its activation threshold minus hysteresis. |
| PWM frequency | `fuelPumpPwmFrequency` | Hz | 1 … 3000 | PWM command frequency. Use a compatible pump controller or power driver and its specified frequency. Burn frequency changes. |
| Minimum active duty | `fuelPumpMinDuty` | % | 0 … 100 | Minimum duty while pressure control is active, including relief or an invalid control result. An inactive pump always receives zero duty. |
| Maximum / prime duty | `fuelPumpMaxDuty` | % | 0 … 100 | Maximum running duty and key-on prime duty. |
| P gain | `fuelPumpControl_pFactor` |  | -10000 … 10000 |  |
| I gain | `fuelPumpControl_iFactor` |  | -10000 … 10000 |  |
| D gain | `fuelPumpControl_dFactor` |  | -10000 … 10000 |  |
| Minimum PID correction | `fuelPumpControl_minValue` |  | -30000 … 30000 | Output Min Duty Cycle |
| Maximum PID correction | `fuelPumpControl_maxValue` |  | -30000 … 30000 | Output Max Duty Cycle |
| Minimum integral correction | `fuelPump_iTermMin` | % | -100 … 100 | Minimum integral correction. |
| Maximum integral correction | `fuelPump_iTermMax` | % | -100 … 100 | Maximum integral correction. |
| Low-demand pressure relief | `fuelPumpAggressiveRelief` | choice |  | Hold minimum active duty during low-demand overpressure. Intended for returnless systems. Feedback resumes below the recovery threshold or when fuel demand increases. |
| Relief below injected mass | `fuelPumpReliefMaxInjectedMass` | mg | 0 … 2000 | Relief is eligible below this injected mass per cycle. |
| Engage overpressure | `fuelPumpReliefEngageOverpressure` | kPa | 0 … 500 | Engage relief above target pressure plus this value. |
| Recovery overpressure | `fuelPumpReliefRecoverOverpressure` | kPa | 0 … 500 | Release relief at or below target plus this value. Set below the engagement threshold. |
